decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The works to which this consent relates, must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of this consent.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - No development shall take place until samples of the materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the hereby permitted have been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority.  Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details

Condition : 4 - Details of external brickwork, pointing, mortar, and bonding shall be in accordance with the advice given in Technical Note 1 of the Bedford Park Society's handbook for residents and architects and should be approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 5 - Details of joinery shall be in accordance with the advice given in Technical Note 3 of the Bedford Park Society's handbook for residents and architects and should be approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.
description: Erection of a single storey rear infill conservatory to the house
